sloka: रिपुः प्रच्छन्न चारी त्वम् मत् अर्थम् अनुगच्छसि ।राघवस्य अन्तर प्रेप्सुः तथा एनम् न अभिपद्यसे ॥३-५९-१९॥
transliteration: ripuḥ pracchanna cārī tvam mat artham anugacchasi ।rāghavasya antara prepsuḥ tathā enam na abhipadyase ॥3-59-19॥

translations.english: 'You are an enemy moving in disguise with an interest in me. You are waiting for an opportunity to set aside Rama. That is why you are not rushing to him.'
